season.evidence: WebSearch of Mountaineers/SummitPost/WTA reports: June to early September mostly snow-free, snow patches on the Nason Ridge approach into June, late-spring snow climbs; ascent histogram peaks Jun-Sep. Stored May-Sep kept.

track.why: Catalog holds exactly one route on Howard. Logged route S Slope from Merritt Lake, 23 Sep 2023, solo, summit within 6 m of our pin, round trip starts 24 m and ends 50 m from our trailhead pin; report describes Crescent Lake, alder band, steep gully then grass/heather slopes to summit = our South Slope line.

facts.text: Directly above Crescent Lake the first few hundred feet are the real crux: slide alder fills the slope, so weave between openings; heading up the boulders at the lake's far west end runs into cliffs and a short bushwhack.
In June and early July mosquitoes are heavy at the trailhead and in the Royal Creek basin.

notes: Only one Howard route stored. Many other recordings are Mastiff/Nason Ridge loops. Merritt Lake trailhead pin matches all Merritt tracks (4-50 m); no pin change.
